## Concerns
- claim-4 is false as stated and contradicts the Strategy. Given the integral surjection \(\mathbb Z^N\twoheadrightarrow Q\) from the specified generators, proving \(\dim_{\mathbb Q}(Q\otimes\mathbb Q)=N\) forces the kernel to have rank \(0\); as a subgroup of \(\mathbb Z^N\), it is torsion-free and hence zero. The examples in claim-4 lack this aligned \(N\)-generator surjection and do not obstruct the argument.

## Unresolved certificates
